notes.title: Holier than thou
notes.content:
Holier than thou

Clerics were not as well defined as I wanted them to be and healing felt very dissatisfying. I have given each cleric a heal spell on m2 with no cooldown and a relatively low energy cost and an instant faith defined ability on 1.
This allows them to work as healers in a party either with energy generation through melee spam or prayer.
I want to give each cleric an m1 to further define their faith in the future but for now, they have weapon attacks or prayer.

Clerics

 All faiths except Aden, m2: Heal 1s cast, concentration
 Cleric of Aden, m2: Heal .25s cast, concentration, short-range
 Cleric of Aden, 1: Smite melee attack that stacks empowered
 Cleric of Callysta, 1: Bless .25s cast heal, 2 charges
 Cleric of Dwade, 1: Bless .25s cast close heal, target gains durable
 Cleric of Ianna, 1: Bless .25s cast close heal, target gains regenerate
 Cleric of Oran, 1: Bless .25s cast close heal, target gains empowered


General

 Wolves no longer cause bleeding and will only use swift attacks
 Creatures in level 1 instances cause 40% reduced damage
 Bow attacks have been changed, from all attacks having 1s cast and no concentration to:

 Quick shot: .75s cast, .5 damage multiplier
 Power shot: 1s cast, 1 damage multiplier, concentration
 Aimed shot: 2s cast, 3 damage multiplier, concentration

 All missiles travel 16% slower
 Touch attack activation has been increased from .25s to .4s
 Staff m2 now parries instead of blocks
 Two-hand weapons increase melee range by 10 (base range is 35)
 Alchemist ranks now improve healing potion effectiveness:

 All ranks reduce the cooldown by 3s
 Rank 2: Regeneration
 Rank 4: 30 Energy gained
 Rank 6: Cleanse one condition
 Rank 8: 30 Energy gained (for a total of 60)
 Rank 10: Cleanse an additional condition (two conditions cleansed)

 Stealth duration up from 3s to 10s
 Experience from clearing/completing instances increased by 400%
 DoT damage decreased by 25% (still subject to change, it's very hard to balance)


As always, any feedback is greatly appreciated.

May The Five watch over you.

notes.title: A small achievement
notes.content:
Small update

Today I have made some small stability adjustments to the server and I have used the opportunity to roll out a few new achievements, enjoy.

Fixes and features

 24 New achievements.
 Acolyte: Boon has been reworked and is now a personal heal.
 Wand: Flare was not supposed to allow movement while casting, this has been fixed.
 Server stability fixes along with the ability to have the server automatically restart when running poorly.
 Fixed a bug that had instant cast touch spell misfire when target was moving fast.

notes.title: Patch notes, 1.2.3 Steam release - Merchants and Wiches
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.3 - Merchants and Wiches
In the world of Realmstone you can now find little huts that may either contain a helpful merchant or a wicked witch, both can grant you fabulous rewards but at what risk? A witches curse is no laughing matter. 

Become lord of the lands!
You can now claim ownership of your faction's cities by talking to their mayors, each city owned increases the power of your champions.

A lot of new features has been added but my main focus has been on fixing existing issues, adding quality of life improvements and optimizing server stability.

Changes

Server backup
Servers now has a save dated backups in a separate folder.
AI Aggression
Enemies will spend less time waiting between attacks.
Rain
Rain is now more visible.
DoT damage
DoT damage has been reduced by roughly 65%.
DoT stacks
DoT stacks now fall off as the duration decreases.
Arrow speed
Arrows are now bigger and travel 20% slower.
Missile range
All missiles travel slightly further.
Speech in XML
Npc speech is now saved as XML in the data folder.
Slower world travel
All movement on the world map has been reduced roughly 20%.
Potion vendor
Potions are now acquired by hiring a alchemist servant.
Chained risen
Chain attack has been reworked.
Channeled melee
A new type of attacks has been implemented (Frenzy for Berserker and [strike]Thousand cuts[/strike] Shank for Assassin).
You are not you own ally
Abilities that effects allies no longer hit you as well, some abilities has been reworked to make up for this.
Spider cult
The spider cult has been reworked and they now have spider totems that spawn spiderlings.
Urgerised
Urgerisen liches now has access to flamestorm, a new type of spell and Urgerisen zombies can now make themselves explode.
Plague zombies
Plague has been reworked and now causes damage over time and snare.
Wyldoverload
Some shaman can now overload themselves with wyld energies causing massive explosions (new ability type).
Wizard
A new neutral class  with access to slow travelling orb attacks.
Focus/Pray
Generator for clerics and sages has been completely reworked, this is now a self cast ability that generates energy.
Precision tool tip
Precision is now included in ability tool tip calculations.
Fire effect
The burning effect is now more visible.
Ray attacks
Ray attacks have had a massive visual overhaul.
Merchants and Witches
Old huts now spawn on the map, these will contain either a neutral merchant, that will sell you am item based on your champion level, or an aggressive witch.
Loot
The random loot generator has been completely reworked and is now based on the random item upgrades from the crafting engine.
Farewell Parnassus
The faithless neutral faction is no longer a player faction.
Missile angles
Missile angle can be changed during the cast animation, this should make slow cast missiles a lot more viable.
Player cities
You can now buy the cities owned by your faction by talking to a new mayor npc found in all cities not overrun by monsters. Talking to a mayor in a city you already own, will open a menu from which you can control what the city should build. Beware though, the less gold a city has, the easier it is for another player to buy the title from you.
Donations
You can now donate money to a city by finding the city gold stack and interacting with it.
House power
Each house now has a new House power stat, this is a percentage that is added to all that houses champions health and damage dealt. You can increase you house power by claiming cities, hover your mouse over you house power to see your current holdings.


Fixes

Server time step fix
Server time between updates is now more rigidly monitored to prevent loss of 'frames' and desynchronization.
Ghosts Champions
Champions should no longer ghost in the middle of the world map.
Arcane light fix
Arcane light should no longer go out when reapplied.
Resource turn in
Opening inventory after entering home town should now display the correct amount of resources.
Speed calculations
All haste, snare and root calculations have been reworked, this should hopefully put an end to speed calculations bugging when equipping haste abilities while being snared.
AI Performance
Enemies are a lot less likely to get confused in a target rich environment.
Wider banners
Champion name banners now fit their name.

notes.title: Let the stones sing
notes.content:
The stones are humming and soon they will sing.

Release date has been set to 26 juli to give me time to run everything over just once more.

On release it is very important to note that this is not an MMO, if you have issues playing on the online server please play local, host your own or join a community server.

Here are the current patch notes for 1.2.2:

General

 Cool downs are now name based, meaning that you can no longer equip the same ability twice
 Creatures will no longer try to flank when they are alone
 It is now possible to attack in melee with bows
 Player spell trajectories are no longer fixed on Y axis
 Action cast timers should be slightly better synchronized now
 Fiber is a lot less rare
 Crafting quality has been slightly increased
 A lot of tool tip fixes
 Dual wielding fixed
 Server will push ability and class settings to clients on connect
 Orcs do no longer dual wield weapons
 End of level chests will now return loot lost in instance due to death
 Dots/Hots ticks twice as fast
 Item enchants implemented (Glyphs, Gems and Sigils)


Sage

 Added ray effect to touch spells
 Arcane light no longer stacks
 Slightly faster cast times for all abilities
 Shadowbolt damage increased
 Wyldbolt damage increased
 Urgemage self burn increased
 Urgebolt damage increased


Soldier

 Health increased by 15%
 Leap attack can no longer change your facing
 Charge animation smoother
 Blocking a missile attack now counters all effects of that missile (Including summoning)
 Missile reflection ability temporarily disabled
 Knockback no longer interrupts soldier melee attacks


Cleric

 Heals are 25% stronger and can crit
 Precision no longer works on heals
 Most damage abilities have been buffed
 Heal spells now work like touch spells
 Base health increased by 5%
